skillset.skill: 50s CT - 8000% Light DMG (Magic). Reduce enemies' Light resistance by 30% for 10s. If the user is Demon, reduce enemies' Light resistance by 50% instead.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Shalltear, Increase own Arts by 2/s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: When Near-death, heal 1% of own DMG dealt.
